# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

import json
from pathlib import Path
ids=sorted(json.loads(Path('/kubelet-devices/kubelet_internal_checkpoint').read_text())['Data']['RegisteredDevices']['nvidia.com/gpu'])
if len(ids)!=32 or len(set(ids))!=32:raise ValueError('Expected 32 unique registered full-GPU devices')
for i in range(4):
 p=json.loads(Path('/mock-config/config-'+str(i)+'.yaml').read_text())
 for j,d in enumerate(p['devices']):d['uuid']=ids[8*i+j]
 Path('/runtime/config-'+str(i)+'.yaml').write_text(json.dumps(p))
Path('/runtime/devices.json').write_text(json.dumps(ids))
